summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for Phase 9 / B4 Identity & Dedupe features. Tested phone normalization (+62 format), dedupe on customer creation, auto-link Lead→Customer, lead/quotation convert dedupe, Contact 360 view with aggregation, and RBAC. 66/69 tests passed (95.7%). The 3 'failures' are actually correct behavior - dedupe system detecting existing customers with matching normalized phones.

backend_issues.notes: No critical bugs found. All B4 features working as designed. The 3 test 'failures' are due to test design (attempting to create customers with phones that normalize to existing customer phones), not actual bugs.

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend testing skipped as per instructions (backend only)

passed_tests: Authentication: All 3 users (owner, ops_admin, driver) login successfully
Phone normalization: Correctly normalizes various formats (08xx, 62xx, 8xx, +62 with spaces) to +62 E.164 format
Dedupe on customer creation: Returns 409 conflict when phone/email matches existing customer, mentions existing customer name in error
Dedupe on customer creation: Allows creating customer with unique phone, sets phone_normalized correctly
Dedupe by email: Returns 409 when email matches existing customer (phone empty)
Auto-link Lead→Customer: Lead created with matching phone has linked_customer_id set and phone_normalized
Auto-link Lead→Customer: Lead with non-matching phone has linked_customer_id null
Lead convert dedupe: Converting lead with matching phone returns existing customer (created: false), no duplicate created
Lead convert dedupe: Lead stage set to 'won', converted_customer_id and linked_customer_id set
Lead convert dedupe: Converting lead with unique phone creates new customer (created: true) with phone_normalized
Quotation convert dedupe: Quotation created with phone_normalized set
Quotation convert dedupe: Converting quotation (create→send→accept→convert flow) with matching phone reuses existing customer
Quotation convert dedupe: Returns customer and booking objects, no duplicate customer created
Contact 360 view: GET /api/customers/{id} returns expanded object with bookings, leads, quotations, conversations arrays
Contact 360 view: Returns unified timeline sorted descending by date with typed entries (booking/quotation/lead/conversation)
Contact 360 view: Returns stats object with bookings_count, total_spent, active_bookings, leads_count, quotations_count, conversations_count
Contact 360 view: CV Sentosa Wisata customer has leads_count >= 1 and timeline has lead entry (from seed)
Contact 360 aggregation: Creating customer, lead, and quotation with same phone aggregates all in customer detail
Contact 360 aggregation: Leads and quotations arrays include records matched via linked_customer_id and phone_normalized
Contact 360 aggregation: Stats reflect aggregated data (leads_count, quotations_count)
RBAC customers section: Unauthenticated returns 401, driver returns 403, owner/ops_admin return 200
RBAC crm section: Unauthenticated returns 401, driver returns 403 for leads, owner/ops_admin return 200
Regression: PATCH /api/customers/{id} recomputes phone_normalized when phone changes
Regression: DELETE /api/customers/{id} with bookings returns 400 with error mentioning bookings
Regression: B1 pricing endpoint (GET /api/pricing/rules) still works (200)
Regression: B2 quotations endpoint (GET /api/quotations) still works (200)
Regression: B3 content endpoint (GET /api/content/destinations) still works (200)
Regression: Bookings endpoint (GET /api/bookings) still works (200)
